With `version=2`, `escape_markdown` takes the `elif int(version) == 2` branch. Because the test does not pass an `entity_type`, it falls into the final `else` there and sets `escape_chars` to `r"\_*[]()~`>#+-=|{}.!"`. The return statement uses `re.sub` to prefix every occurrence of any of those characters in the input text with a backslash, so each markdown-special character and each existing backslash in the source string is escaped once.
